title: Service Basics
tagline: Confidence-building fundamentals for new servers and hosts.
summary: Service isn't a personality — it's a repeatable set of moves. This course covers greeting, table management, upselling without being pushy, handling complaints, and running a section on a busy Saturday.
outcomes: Greet, seat, and read a table correctly
Upsell appetizers and wine without feeling slimy
Handle a guest complaint so they come back
Run a 6-top section during a rush without a ticket getting lost

modules.title: The art of the suggestive sell
